column1: # gencodev50.mapping_patch.tsv
# gene_name <-> gene_id disambiguation patch for
# gencode.v50.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz, covering every gene name that
# GTF_HLA_GENE_ID_CHECK rejects in the default HLA region
# Apply with scripts/patch_gtf_gene_ids.py; see docs/usage.md
# "Patching a rejected GTF" for the invocation. Applying this patch makes the
# mapping one-to-one in the HLA region and the check exits 0.
# Provenance: every gene_id and attribute below was read directly from the
# `gene` rows of gencode.v50.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz (sha-verified
# copy at /mnt/vol/hlarnaseq-data/hlarnases-testdata/reference/), not from
# memory. Compiled 2026-09-10.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   1  gene_id        the gene to act on, version suffix included
#   2  new_gene_name  the gene_name it should carry after patching; leave the
#                     column off to remove that gene and all of its nested
#                     entries instead
# This patch renames only - nothing is removed, so the patched GTF has exactly
# as many lines as the input. Every gene_id NOT listed here is left untouched.
# Primary-ID choice
# HLA-DRB6, HLA-H, HLA-L and HLA-V each have exactly two GENCODE v50 records: a
# large lncRNA locus and a small transcribed_unprocessed_pseudogene nested
# inside it. The lncRNA keeps the plain gene name and is therefore absent from
# this file; only the pseudogene is renamed. The primary ids left untouched are:
#   HLA-DRB6   ENSG00000290878.2   (the convention the other three follow)
# POLR1HASP is a deliberate exception, decided by the scientific team: its
# transcribed_unitary_pseudogene record (ENSG00000204623.12) is GENCODE level 1
# (validated) while the lncRNA is level 2, so the pseudogene is primary here -
# and so it is the lncRNA that gets renamed - even though that breaks
# consistency with the four rows above.
# Y_RNA is not an ambiguous gene at all - it is a family symbol (Rfam-derived Y
# RNA) shared by 758 equivalent misc_RNA level-3 copies genome-wide, 7 of them
# in the MHC. There is no primary ID to pick, so all 7 in-region copies are
# renamed per locus instead. This is what takes the name out of scope: the
# check counts gene_ids genome-wide, so as long as any in-region gene is still
# called Y_RNA the remaining 751 off-region copies keep it ambiguous. The new
# names must be distinct from each other - renaming all 7 to one shared name
# does not fix it. Ordered by MHC coordinate. The 751 off-region copies are
# deliberately not listed: they are genuinely different genes that happen to
# share a symbol, and nothing here touches them.
gene_id
